module_summary: Clock-domain-crossing FIFO split into source and destination halves; the source-side register array is read asynchronously while write/read pointers cross via 2-phase req/ack links.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain payload written into the FIFO array

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready, deasserted when FIFO full

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain payload read from FIFO array

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid when read pointer differs from write pointer

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready advancing the read pointer

anchors.name: async_data
anchors.why: FIFO data array held in source domain, read by destination

anchors.name: async_wptr_data
anchors.why: Write pointer sent to destination over 2-phase CDC

anchors.name: async_rptr_data
anchors.why: Read pointer returned to source over 2-phase CDC for full detection

groups.name: Source half
groups.description: Writes words into array and tracks write pointer and full

groups.name: Destination half
groups.description: Reads array via local read pointer and derives valid

groups.name: Pointer CDC links
groups.description: 2-phase req/ack crossings for write and read pointers
